enchantment.gear_forge.lightning_arrow.d: Summons lightning on hit, +10% lightning dmg/lvl
enchantment.gear_forge.frost_arrow.desc: Slows and damages target, longer slow duration per lvl
message.gear_forge.no_gear: Please hold the gear item in your other hand!
message.gear_forge.max_level: Gear is already at max upgrade level!
message.gear_forge.use_smithing_table: Please use this item on a Smithing Table!
message.gear_forge.max_sockets: Gear has no more room for gems!
message.gear_forge.incompatible_gem: This gem is not compatible with this gear!
message.gear_forge.gem_max_tier: Gem is already at max tier!
message.gear_forge.offhand_mode_on: Offhand mode enabled! Weapon effects will apply when held in off-hand.
message.gear_forge.offhand_mode_off: Offhand mode disabled! Weapon effects will apply when held in main hand.
message.gear_forge.reincarnation_success: Reincarnation successful! Upgrade, affix, and gem stats are permanently retained.
message.gear_forge.reincarnation_fail_le: Gear is not at max upgrade level, cannot reincarnate!
tooltip.gear_forge.forge_hammer: Place in the smithing table's material slot with a gear to upgrade it (Max +15)
tooltip.gear_forge.upgrade_crystal: Place a gem in the smithing table's equipment slot and this in the material slot to enhance the gem's effects (Max Tier 5)
tooltip.gear_forge.reroll_stone: Place in the smithing table's material slot to grant random affixes (1~5 affixes)
tooltip.gear_forge.transfer_orb: Place in the smithing table's material slot to toggle the weapon between main-hand and off-hand mode
tooltip.gear_forge.gem_remover: Place in the smithing table's material slot to remove the most recently socketed gem from the equipment
tooltip.gear_forge.reincarnation_stone: When your gear reaches +15, place this in the material slot and 8 Netherite Blocks in the template slot to Reincarnate. The gear will inherit all upgrades, affixes, and gem bonuses. (Gear must have full gem sockets to reincarnate; if you cannot fill all sockets, reincarnate without any gems first.)
tooltip.gear_forge.curse_anvil: When equipped: Neutral Hostile | EXP Gain +15% | Enchantment Level Requirement -5
